findings: Deployed checkout writes payment rows directly after creating a provider session; it does not claim a durable attempt first.
Deployed checkout uses configured venue fee when positive; its legacy PHP 150 fallback is not the current PHP 1 configured amount.
Payment mode and webhook behavior were not tested; no provider endpoint was invoked.
payment-maintenance and private-upload are absent from deployed function metadata.
conclusion: Database upgrade alone does not validate paid checkout or proof upload.
